families.backend_consequence: A debug assertion or unwrap fails if an internal compiler-owned invariant is broken.

families.backend_consequence: Mismatched, dead, or foreign allocation provenance can cause undefined behavior.

families.backend_consequence: The random-step intrinsic writes through a raw output pointer on success.

families.backend_consequence: Invalid ranges or prohibited overlap can cause undefined behavior or corruption.

families.backend_consequence: Widening loads read multiple source elements through a raw pointer.

families.review: The typed result-target relationship owns the exact required source extent.
